name: Tominator T-73
description: A more aggressive fork of tominator-t72-stock-market-2, deliberately maximizing its real-event-driven big-win mechanism: bets nearly full portfolio value (or a much larger share of available margin) on a real event's trustworthy direction, keeps adding to an event-driven position even while temporarily underwater (unlike the mean-reversion signal, which stays exactly as conservative as T-72), and loosens its risk backstops just enough to let a real winning position run further. Higher variance than T-72 by design.
